method_card.title: How to Use Tree Diagrams
method_card.content:
Probability runs from 0 (impossible) to 1 (certain), and \(P(A') = 1 - P(A)\).

For combined events, multiply along the branches (AND) and add complete paths (OR). With replacement the fractions stay the same; without replacement the numerator and denominator each fall by 1 at every draw.
